svg.text: V13 HIERARCHICAL VERIFICATION HARNESS & AGENTIC AB-MCTS ("MOVE 37" ENGINE)
Context-Bounded Layers (L0 → L1-A → L2 → L1-B) Powered by Self-Hosted Reflection Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-NVFP4 + DFlash2 (8-Token Speculative Decoding)
STAGE 1 — LAYER L1-A: EPHEMERAL RECONNAISSANCE PROBE
0–6 Turns | Scratchpad Garbage-Collected on Exit | Zero Context Pollution into L0
• 0 LLM Turns when file/symbol paths are explicit
• Locates primary fault surface + upstream data producers
• Verified to FAIL on clean git HEAD before search begins
• Raw grep / file dumps discarded when L1-A exits
• Prevents 40k+ token exploration rot in downstream agents
STAGE 2 — LAYER L0: SEED ARCHITECT & AGENTIC AB-MCTS CONTROLLER
Clean Strategic Ledger (< 4K Tokens) | Never Edits Code Directly | Thompson Sampling over Git Checkpoints
• Anti-Cheat Rules (no test deletion, no broadening
• Draws θ_a ~ Beta(α_a, β_a) per branch & checkpoint
• GEN(b_k): Widen search on untested orthogonal branch
• Maintains Negative Evidence Ledger of refuted diffs
• Escapes local optima automatically via Beta decay
STAGE 3 — LAYER L2: EPHEMERAL CLEAN-CONTEXT EXECUTORS (BEAM-501B + DFLASH2)
Fresh Context Window per Node | 0.8s–3.5s/turn with 8-Token Speculative Decoding
• Starts from clean git checkout -f HEAD
• Interactive ReAct tools: view_file, bash, str_replace, submit
• Bounded 8–18 turns; full scratchpad GC'd upon return
• Pre-applies parent checkpoint s_i git diff in /testbed
• Starts at Turn 0 with 0 tokens of parent's exploration noise
• Receives exact failing pytest traceback or L1-B critique
• Surgically repairs remaining edge cases in 6–12 turns
• DFlash2 drafts 8 tokens/step in a single forward pass
STAGE 4 — LAYER L1-B: POPPERIAN VERIFICATION GATE & ADVERSARIAL FALSIFIER
Independent Read-Only Auditor | Appends Persistent Adversarial Tests | Eliminates Self-Oracle Bias
• 1. Syntax & import check (py_compile on modified files)
• 3. Runs target pytest module + accumulated falsifier suite
• Ephemeral read-only auditor (cannot edit repository code)
• Audits candidate git diff against L0 VerificationContract
• Authors adversarial edge-case, None/empty & subclass tests
• Passes repro + target pytest + adversarial falsifiers
Feedback Loop on Failure: Empirical Score V(s_i) + <400-Token Critique Updates Beta(α_i, β_i) & Negative Ledger
